limitations: Historical instrumented/concurrent development timings are resource quotes, not isolated COST-02 measurements.
M01 has no recorded elapsed fields; E/T timing remains unavailable rather than being imputed.
A02 and Pmatched development timings only cover their originally executed SNR/configuration grid.
Storage counts use file sizes only; this extraction does not re-audit NPZ payloads or scientific results.
Missing preparation, generation, IO or CPU metrics remain unmeasured; do not interpret them as zero.
Per-record variability is descriptive; cross-SNR rows do not increase independent channel counts.
